title: Add a fourth sound
summary: A seventh chord extends a triad.

steps.title: Add a fourth sound
steps.body:
**seventh chord** means a chord with the three different notes of a triad plus a seventh above its root: four different note names. Start with C, E and G, then add B. The gap from C to B is a seventh.

**Why it matters:** One extra sound changes the colour without replacing the familiar triad.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: Play C, E and G first; clear with Escape and add B as well. Repeated notes can fill a guitar shape, but they do not add another different note name.

items.prompt: Play C, E, G and B together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Compare the four-note sound with the plain triad. The next lessons name the different kinds.
